title: Dereth Town Tour - Bluespire scratch

shots.standingOrder: Fly east at 45 m straight over the Viamontian tower toward the glittering morning sea, keeping the tower in frame down through the vertical and out behind.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING (drone.pass-over). Flies east at 45 m (13 m over the tallest delta trees) straight over the gold-roofed Viamontian tower 'in the middle of town' at 8 m/s toward the glittering morning sea; the gimbal tracks the tower down through nadir with a gentle 60 deg/s yaw-slew and keeps it framed behind as the delta and coast open up. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (6326.8,33928.8,45.0) end (6454.8,33928.8,45.0), min AGL 45.0 m, nearest static/building/tree 19.8 m (0x21B0#59 0x010036E3), peak 8.0 m/s; WBT get-height at 5 path samples matched the checker terrain to 0.00 m.

shots.standingOrder: Stand low south of the Viamontian tower behind the glowing Life Stone and tilt slowly up from its base to the golden roof against the morning sky.
shots.notes: LANDMARK (classic.tilt). Lens 2.4 m above the mud 30 m south of the Viamontian tower with the glowing Life Stone 8 m ahead in the lower frame; tilts 34 deg up from the tower's base past its window slits to the golden tapered roof against the cool morning sky. shots.standingOrder: Arc slowly at head height around the octagonal Aun hall past the blue-flame braziers flanking its north-west door.
shots.notes: FLAME (classic.arc). 6 m above the reeds, 26 m from the octagonal Aun hall (0x0100229B), arcing 60 deg clockwise from W to NNW past its north-west door flanked by big blue-flame braziers (0x020009A3, blue tongues 0.78 m); the low morning sun behind the hall rims the roof and the blue flames glow on the shadow side. shots.standingOrder: Frame the glowing Life Stone and the swirling Town Network portal together beneath the Viamontian tower, drifting gently.
shots.notes: PARTICLE FX (classic.two-shot). The Life Stone and the Town Network portal swirl, 16 m apart, framed together from the north at 3.9 m with a slow 8 deg drift; the spire-roofed hall and the delta trees behind, side light from the east. shots.standingOrder: Start close on the crackling Viamontian magic crowning the great blue sword and pull back and up to reveal the tower, the Life Stone and the delta town.
shots.notes: MAGIC FX + CLOSING (classic.pull-out-reveal). Starts at MCU on the crown of the 8.9 m Viamontian banner-sword (0x02000ABC) wrapped in its energy props (0x02000997: gas, lightning, tendril/orb cluster) and pulls back and up 27 m to a 28 deg WS, revealing the tower, Life Stone, portal and the delta town; backlit by the morning sun.
